title: J1939 Network Configuration
text: Define J1939 network configuration name and database file; {Configuration name} defines a name for this J1939 network configuration, {Database File} sets the J1939 database file name relative to the current folder not and {Enable address claiming} enables standard address claim procedure. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Configuration name
params.values: Define a name for this J1939 network configuration ConfigX (default) | character vector

params.name: Database File
params.values: Specify the J1939 database file name relative to the current folder not set (default) | character vector

params.name: Enable address claiming
params.values: Enable standard address claim procedure on (default) | off
